Definition: an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies
BiblicalUsage: Eliphaz claims our adversary is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumes. The word is the opponent, the one who rises up against.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliphaz was wrong about Job, but the word is right: the one who rises against us is cut down in the end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
